Level_1
- Sandstorm at the edge of the map reshaped and remodeled 
- Added new visual effects
- Aurora borealis visible only at night
- Fixed collision problem with TItan enemy
- Added new environmental sounds
- Increased the lighting distance of the flashlight
- Added new materials
- Improved performance
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/0e0f7f0c4b0d094e4fe86ce16e3ef0a751270d1b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/07645ef97907fadf8bc897d3323e97777d63f68e.jpg[/img][/url]

Level_2
- Added new visual effects
- Remodeled and improved initial trap hatches
- Increased the lighting distance of the flashlight
- Added new materials
- Improved performance
- Fixed problem of some materials not correctly rendered
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/fb4acc02cce31122147b8d77c95314975e4d530c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/3bede2b0f2c6c2aae35758621a9af703f055fed9.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you all for your support and advices
